Definition: properly, an exalted one, i.e. a king or sheik; also a rising mist
BiblicalUsage: The princes of the tribes stand before Moses at the numbering, and princes are set over the divisions of the land. Solomon is kept as prince for David's sake, and the LORD promises David as prince among His flock for ever.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God raises up princes and sets them down by His own hand. The exalted one is only ever exalted because the LORD lifted him, and the prince who forgets that falls like any other man.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
